competitors.name: Enhancv
competitors.weakness: cannot match to a specific job posting

market_size: Jobscan alone ~$10M+/yr revenue; category growing with AI hiring tools

positioning_wedge.insight: Every major competitor forces a monthly subscription. Almost none offer a one-time price.
positioning_wedge.our_play: $9 one-time single-optimization removes subscription friction; $19/mo unlimited for power users (job seekers applying to many roles).
positioning_wedge.differentiator: Job-specific matching (beats Enhancv) + affordable (beats Jobscan/Rezi) + no subscription lock-in (beats everyone)

pricing_recommendation.rationale: Undercuts Enhancv monthly ($19.99) at parity, massively undercuts Jobscan ($49.95). One-time $9 captures the 'I just need this one application fixed' buyer that no competitor serves well.
